en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a large, ornate historic building with a central pavilion and two symmetrical side wings. The architecture is 19th‑century eclectic/neo‑Renaissance with arched colonnades, decorative facades, and steep mansard-style roofs topped with finials and flagpoles. In front of the building is a formal garden with flowerbeds arranged in decorative patterns, trimmed shrubs, and a circular path. A few people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the paths.
